description: Exposes Android's native toast functionality to React Native. Allows showing brief messages on the screen with optional positioning and offset. Available only on Android.

show.description: Displays a toast message for a short or long duration at the default position (bottom of the screen).

parameters.message: string - The text to display in the toast
parameters.duration: number - Duration of the toast; either ToastAndroid.SHORT or ToastAndroid.LONG

showWithGravity.signature: static showWithGravity(message: string, duration: number, gravity: number)
showWithGravity.description: Displays a toast message at a specific position on the screen. Works only on Android API 29 and below.

parameters.gravity: number - Toast position; one of ToastAndroid.TOP, ToastAndroid.BOTTOM, ToastAndroid.CENTER

showWithGravity.note: Starting Android 11 (API 30), gravity has no effect. Consider using Snackbar for newer versions.

showWithGravityAndOffset.signature: static showWithGravityAndOffset(message: string, duration: number, gravity: number, xOffset: number, yOffset: number)
showWithGravityAndOffset.description: Displays a toast message at a specific position with X/Y pixel offsets. Works only on Android API 29 and below.

SHORT.description: Displays the toast for a short duration

LONG.description: Displays the toast for a long duration

TOP.description: Toast appears at the top of the screen

BOTTOM.description: Toast appears at the bottom of the screen

CENTER.description: Toast appears at the center of the screen

notes: ToastAndroid is Android-only; iOS requires a different approach (e.g., using third-party libraries).
For Android 11+, gravity and offset do not affect text toasts.
Snackbar or notification libraries are recommended for advanced toast positioning on newer Android versions.
